claims.rationale: Opponent estimate of the pursuing force, not all simultaneously attacking the bridges or matched French return; unit counts not converted into a new headcount. English rendering (ours): "Grouchy marched toward Wavre in pursuit with fifty thousand men, fifty-three battalions, fourteen batteries and sixty-three squadrons."

claims.value: Vaudoncourt gives side B’s remainder as 20,000 infantry and 4,500 “chevaux” after Bork left. For the final June 19 line he gives side B 17,000 infantry/4,500 chevaux and side A 18,000 infantry/4,000 chevaux, with other troops still in/front of Wavre. Horses/cavalry terms are retained, not silently counted as people.
claims.rationale: Different moments and local components. No whole-army substitution, original return authentication or correction of Plotho/Bodart. English rendering (ours): "After Bork departed: twenty thousand infantry and forty-five hundred horses. Final line: seventeen thousand infantry and forty-five hundred horses; Grouchy eighteen thousand infantry and four thousand horses, with the remainder in and before Wavre."

claims.value: Grouchy had overall pursuing command, Vandamme the attacks on Wavre and Gérard the Bierge operation before the crossing at Limale. Thielemann retained local defense under Blücher’s instruction, with Bork’s departing brigade separate.
claims.rationale: Army/corps/local scopes and departing troops separated; no equal credit or claim that Blücher personally commanded at Wavre throughout. English rendering (ours): "Grouchy commanded the force; Gérard attempted Bierge; Blücher ordered Thielemann to remain provisionally; Thielemann directed the local defense."
